purpose: 由 VRH 平均方法得到的体模量和剪切模量计算材料的泊松比 σ。

symbols.meaning: bulk modulus calculated by the VRH (Voigt-Reuss-Hill) approximation method
shear modulus calculated by the VRH (Voigt-Reuss-Hill) approximation method

unmapped: subscripts R and V denote the Reuss and Voigt averages; VRH denotes the Voigt-Reuss-Hill approximation
B_V and B_R are the bulk modulus calculated by the Voigt and Reuss approximation methods, respectively
G_V and G_R denote the shear modulus calculated by the Voigt and Reuss approximation methods, respectively
the numerical coefficients 3 and 2 in the formula are constant coefficients of the isotropic elasticity relation (not separately defined in the paper)
